subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

A writer who wrote this book has been selected for this year’s literature award.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **A writer who**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace **"A writer" **with "The writer"</stro
